name: @local/dsh-sac-preset
description: Agent preset `sac`: the standard composition plus the Single-Action Compaction policy, so SAC runs only in sessions that select this preset. 1.3.0 ships the cost-aware policy of @local/dsh-sac-compact 1.3.0 (fold once the request is large enough for a fold to pay for itself); 1.2.0 pinned every user instruction.
